knowledgeAnswers.rationale: Damaged equipment is tagged out and reported for competent inspection.
The method depends on the material collected.
A log must reflect the inspection actually done.

practicalCriteria: Completes a pre-start inspection of each listed part on a simulated extractor.
Tags out a simulated damaged seal and reports it.
Completes a sample equipment log with inspection, quarantine and approval fields.
passRule: Full inspection completed, damaged item tagged out, and log complete with no improvised repair. Observed by an assessor.
